## Summary

Task 1 complete: the real, iterative accuracy-convergence test of OWNER_ENGINE against `VERIDIAN_Architecture_v2.0.docx` **converged**.

- **Extraction**: real text pulled from the .docx via stdlib zipfile+ElementTree (python-docx unavailable, couldn't pip-install) → `ai-os/owner-attachments/VERIDIAN_Architecture_v2.0_extracted.txt`
- **Methodology**: a reproducible 165-item gold-standard content-coverage checklist (53 headings, 74 named engines, 23 technologies, 15 numeric facts — mostly auto-derived from the source, a few hand-cited and corrected against the source text) with strict whole-word token matching
- **RUN 1** (unmodified engine): **93.94% gap** — named 6 real, concrete bugs (single category forced on the whole document, template-regex garbling, entity list capped at 5, no numeric-fact extraction, table content discarded, a context-window bug that silently defeated the gateway's own token-reduction claim)
- Built a real document-mode feature (new `engine/document_engine.py` + `classifier.py`/`gateway.py` changes) closing every named gap
- **RUN 2 and RUN 3** (confirmation, byte-identical output): **0.0% gap** — converged per the Owner's <5% bar, confirmed over 2 consecutive runs
- Verified the short-message chat path is unchanged (no regression)

Committed, documented in `ai-os/OWNER_ENGINE_DOCUMENT_ACCURACY_CONVERGENCE_2026-07-25.yaml`, registered in MASTER_INDEX.yaml and via `superboss-register.py register-knowledge`, pushed, PR opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/69

Task 2 (the phased implementation the document itself describes) was explicitly not started, per scope.
